test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II Official Paper-I (Held On: 18 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question: On the occasion of Republic Day, a retail store offers a scheme where customers can avail a discount of 26% on their total purchase. If Manish buys items worth ₹2,050, how much money (in ₹) will he save through the scheme discount?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Savings = Discount % × Total Purchase Value

Savings = 26% of 2050

Savings = 26 × 20.5 = 533

**∴ The correct answer is ₹533.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total purchase amount = ₹2,050

Discount percentage = 26%

**Formula Used:**

Discount Amount = (Discount % ÷ 100) × Total Value

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/091896219b6abee8202e5c02ffc9fa596146a569b4c1061d32cad021e1beff17.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Savings = (26 ÷ 100) × 2050

⇒ Savings = 0.26 × 2050

⇒ Savings = 26 × 20.5

⇒ Savings = 533

**∴ The correct answer is ₹533.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price (MP) and Discount

Discount is always calculated on the Marked Price or the initial Total Value. Selling Price = Marked Price − Discount.

Successive Discounts

If two successive discounts of a% and b% are given, the effective net discount % = a + b − (a × b) ÷ 100.

Percentage Base Change

When calculating savings, the original purchase amount always acts as the 100% base value.

56:T
